description: Export request for the Warden ability-icon set (#211). The selections below are the approved-png-v1 export selection: naming these exact sha256 values in the export is the approval act (Decision Atlas 4.1.3). This file records the owner's selection that the export carries out; it is not a separate approval state.

supersedes.note: An earlier local approved-png-v1 export named three Stable Diffusion 1.5 candidates for warden.ability.1-3 (sha256 b336e230b85f8d4ce7aa1049ec44d6113a69ac3bb284bab01edf4bd00626906e, 58c5b84f184b2c0c4b7d42e2ec6cd3d1f17b4fc1b6f0a04f52e777e95941c953, 3b905f72beea5f66426df256ceab9f55a80774723c973dc54fa8fe6a92fc14fa; manifest sha256 e4788f1b...1dfe). It was never committed or distributed. The owner's selection above replaces it for every warden.ability key; this export names none of those bytes.

license.models: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (diffusion model), its Qwen3-4B text encoder and the FLUX.2 VAE are Apache-2.0 according to their official model cards; their revision-pinned files and hashes are recorded in candidates.json and on every master's provenance.

derivation.description: Each derivative is produced from the exact master bytes with the existing image.decode@1, image.resize@1 (bilinear, exact 2x halving steps except one 3/4 step for 48 px) and image.encode.png@1 (compressionLevel 9) operations. Each derivative's exact sha256 is named in the selection, so a different codec build fails visibly instead of silently replacing a pinned file.
